newsitem.title: JAPAN: Casio says sees 97/98 group net profit up 80 pct.
newsitem.headline: Casio says sees 97/98 group net profit up 80 pct.

text.p: Casio Computer Co Ltd said on Thursday that it expects to post a group net profit of about 6.5 billion yen in the year to March 1998, up 80 percent from its estimated profit for the previous year.
The sharp rise in profit is mainly due to strong sales of sports watches and mobile personal computers.
Assuming an average dollar-yen rate during the current business year of 116 yen per dollar, the company's group sales are expected to rise five percent to around 480 billion yen in 1997/98.
Its parent sales in 1997/98 will likely increase seven percent to 370 billion yen, while parent current profit is expected to grow 14 percent to about 12 billion yen.
